verification: Canonical ms41emu executes both real MS41.1 CC6 CALLS hooks, switch/RPM/launch-request cases, all six native single-cylinder masks, stock ANDB replay, cut suppression, and stack/DPP/register hygiene. Physical spark interruption remains an on-car validation item.
title: Ignition Cut
user_description: Adds a configurable ignition-cut rev limiter to MS41.1 at the ECU's six-cylinder coil final-stage charge commands. Vehicle testing is still required.
description: MS41.1 port of Ignition Cut V7. Both recurring `andb P1L,RL1` coil-charge transactions at file 0x3B466 and 0x3B4CA call a shared cave at file 0x3B680. CUTSW/CUTRPM use the dedicated blank calibration tail at SA 0x3700/0x3701. Launch Control V4 may independently request spark cut through fd5a.7. The stock path replays the exact displaced ANDB and the cut path suppresses only that scheduled final-stage charge transaction.
